_coverage.title: New patients book new_patient; telehealth is for follow-ups only.

name: existing_patient_schedules_telehealth_followup
input: Yes, a video follow-up, sometime next week is best. Any time of day is fine.

conversation.content: Hi, I need to schedule a follow-up for my blood pressure meds.
Sure, I can help with that. Can you please send your full name and date of birth so I can find your chart?
Thanks, one moment while I pull up your record.
You’re all set in our system as an existing patient. Did you want an in-person follow-up or a video (telehealth) follow-up?
Video would be great if that’s okay.

grading_criteria:
The assistant must:
- Recognize (from the prior verification) that this is an existing patient requesting a follow-up, so telehealth is allowed.
- Call find_open_slots with visitType set to telehealth_follow_up, not new_patient or follow_up.
- Use a reasonable date range covering “next week” when calling find_open_slots.
- Offer two or three of the returned telehealth_follow_up time options in its reply, without inventing times.
- Not yet call book_appointment in this turn; it must wait for the patient to choose a specific time.
- Keep the reply short, friendly, and plain text (no lists/markdown).

checks.uses_telehealth_followup_visit_type: Does the assistant call find_open_slots with visitType=telehealth_follow_up for this existing patient’s follow-up?
checks.does_not_use_new_patient_for_followup: Does the assistant avoid using the new_patient visit type for this follow-up request?
checks.offers_only_returned_slots: Does the assistant only offer times that match the slots returned by find_open_slots?
checks.defers_booking_until_confirmation: Does the assistant refrain from calling book_appointment and instead wait for the patient to pick one of the offered times?
